sn44.11:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sabhiyo kaccāno ñātike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
sn44.11:1.2: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yenāyasmā sabhiyo kaccāno tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sabhiyena kaccānena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn44.11:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako āyasmantaṃ sabhiyaṃ kaccānaṃ etadavoca
sn44.11:1.4: kiṃ nu kho bho kaccāna hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.11:1.7: kiṃ pana ko kaccāna na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.11:2.1: kiṃ nu kho bho kaccāna hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.11:2.3: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.11:2.4: kiṃ pana bho kaccāna neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.11:2.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.11:3.1: kiṃ nu kho bho kaccāna hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.11:3.4: kiṃ pana bho kaccāna na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.11:3.6: na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vadesi.
sn44.11:3.7: kiṃ nu kho bho kaccāna hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.11:3.9: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vadesi.
sn44.11:3.10: kiṃ pana bho kaccāna neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.11:3.12: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vadesi.
sn44.11:3.13: ko nu kho bho kaccāna hetu ko paccayo yenetaṃ abyākataṃ samaṇena gotamenāti.
sn44.11:3.14: yo ca vaccha hetu yo ca paccayo paññāpanāya rūpīti vā arūpīti vā saññīti vā asaññīti vā nevasaññināsaññīti vā so ca hetu so ca paccayo sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjheyya.
sn44.11:3.15: kena naṃ paññāpayamāno paññapeyya rūpīti vā arūpīti vā saññīti vā asaññīti vā nevasaññināsaññīti vāti.
sn44.11:3.18: yassapassa āvuso ettakena ettakameva taṃpassa bahu ko pana vādo evaṃ abhikkanteti.
